lines.text: فما بلَغَتِ القوْس فهو حِصّة العَشَرَات المجموعة من اختلاف النهار فسلَكْنا فيه ذلك حتّى نُجَدْوِله
lines.plain: فما بلَغَتِ القوْس فهو حِصّة العَشَرَات المجموعة من اختلاف النهار فسلَكْنا فيه ذلك حتّى نُجَدْوِله

lines.text: لجميع البروج بتفاضُل عشْرة اجزاء ففيها كِفاية فيما يُحتاج اليه من عِلْم المطالع المُفْرَدة للبَلَد ولِما وافَقَ
lines.plain: لجميع البروج بتفاضُل عشْرة اجزاء ففيها كِفاية فيما يُحتاج اليه من عِلْم المطالع المُفْرَدة للبَلَد ولِما وافَقَ

lines.text: عرضه. وهذا العَمَل بالجُدَيْوِل المرسوم تحت تربيعة مَرَاتِب المَيْل.
lines.plain: عرضه. وهذا العَمَل بالجُدَيْوِل المرسوم تحت تربيعة مَرَاتِب المَيْل.

lines.text: ﴿ باب ﴾ اذا اردتَّ معرِفة مَسِير القمر المختلِف في الساعة لحِساب الاجتماع والاستقبال فخذ{mL:5}
lines.plain: ﴿ باب ﴾ اذا اردتَّ معرِفة مَسِير القمر المختلِف في الساعة لحِساب الاجتماع والاستقبال فخذ

lines.text: فضل ما بين الشمس والقمر المُحْكَم واعرِف ما يُقابِله في جَداول الزيادة والنُّقصان من حَرَكة
lines.plain: فضل ما بين الشمس والقمر المُحْكَم واعرِف ما يُقابِله في جَداول الزيادة والنُّقصان من حَرَكة

lines.text: القمر في الساعة وهو لكلّ درجة خاصَّةً فما كان من الدقائق فانقُصه من مسير القمر المُخْتَلِف في الساعة
lines.plain: القمر في الساعة وهو لكلّ درجة خاصَّةً فما كان من الدقائق فانقُصه من مسير القمر المُخْتَلِف في الساعة

lines.text: اذا كانت حاصَّة القمر المعدَّلة التي عرَفْتَ مسيرها{n:1} في الساعة من {ov:{0}} الى {ov:صه} ومن {ov:رسه} الى {ov:شس} وزده
lines.plain: اذا كانت حاصَّة القمر المعدَّلة التي عرَفْتَ مسيرها في الساعة من {0} الى صه ومن رسه الى شس وزده

lines.text: على ذلك المسير اذا كانت تلك الحاصّة من {ov:صه} الى {ov:رسه} فما بلَغ بعد الزيادة او النقصان فهو المسير
lines.plain: على ذلك المسير اذا كانت تلك الحاصّة من صه الى رسه فما بلَغ بعد الزيادة او النقصان فهو المسير

lines.text: المُحْكَم فانقُص منه حَرَكة الشمس في الساعة فما بَقِيَ فهو سَبْق القمر.{mL:10}
lines.plain: المُحْكَم فانقُص منه حَرَكة الشمس في الساعة فما بَقِيَ فهو سَبْق القمر.

observations: L01, L02, L04, L05, L07, L08, L09: long joins (فهـو on L01; ولِـما on L02; معرِفـة and, at the end, فخـذ on L04; مـا twice and, at the end, حَرَكـة on L05, whose kāf is drawn long; حاصَّـة on L07; بلَـغ and بعـد on L08; حَرَكـة on L09, whose kāf is drawn long).

The last page of the text: three lines that end a chapter (L01 to L03), a paragraph of six lines (L04 to L09) headed by the word «باب» between two ornamental brackets, a rule with one line of notes under it, and lower down three closing rules; it has no title line, no folio number and no signature. L01 and L02 run the full measure (L01 from 78.3 to 500.2 pt); L03, the short last line of the chapter, stands at the right (228.1 to 500.6 pt). One line stands empty between L03 and L04. L04 is set in at its head (78.0 to 476.5 pt), where the right bracket begins it; L05 to L08 run the full measure (L05 from 77.6 to 500.2 pt); L09, the short last line, stands at the right (197.5 to 499.5 pt). The baselines stand from 127.8 to 368.6 pt down. Nallino's line numbers 5 and 10 stand in the left margin beside L04 and L09 (62.6 to 70.6 pt). Full stops stand after عرضه and at the end of L03 and at the end of L09.

The word باب at the head of L04 stands between two ornamental brackets (the right one 9.4 x 15.5 pt, the left one 9.0 x 15.1 pt). Numerals in a smaller type under bars: on L07 the zero sign of the codex under its own bar ({ov:{0}}, 0; bar 12.2 pt), {ov:صه} (95; 13.2 pt), {ov:رسه} (265; 13.2 pt) and {ov:شس} (360; 13.6 pt); on L08 {ov:صه} (95; 13.2 pt) and {ov:رسه} (265; 13.0 pt). The note figure 1 stands after مسيرها on L07 (3.2 x 6.1 pt). The rule stands from 77.4 to 177.8 pt (100.4 pt long) at 397.4 pt down. The notes are one line (baseline 424.8 pt, from 104.8 to 156.6 pt); its Arabic word, مسيره, has no sign.

The three closing rules stand under the notes, centred on the measure: two rules 128.2 pt long and 1.8 pt thick (from 224.6 to 352.8 pt at 554.2 pt down, and from 224.3 to 352.4 pt at 558.9 pt down) and between them a thinner rule 49.7 pt long and 1.1 pt thick (from 262.8 to 312.5 pt at 556.4 pt down). The rest of the page is blank.
Marks of the master scan that the second copy does not have, and that are not transcribed: a round blot over the alif of اذا before كانت تلك on L08 (4.3 x 3.6 pt).

L01: بلَغَتِ: a fatha over the lām (4.0 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the dot of the ghayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the tā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt). القوْس: a round sukun over the wāw (2.9 x 2.9 pt). حِصّة: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a shadda over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.9 pt). العَشَرَات: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the three dots of the shīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt). فسلَكْنا: a fatha over the lām, printed in two pieces (1.8 x 1.4 and 1.1 x 1.4 pt), and a round sukun over the kāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt). حتّى: a shadda over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt), without a vowel. نُجَدْوِله: a damma over the nūn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the wāw (4.0 x 2.5 pt). فما, فهو, المجموعة, من, اختلاف, النهار, فيه and ذلك have no signs.

L02: بتفاضُل: a damma over the dot of the ḍād (2.9 x 4.7 pt). عشْرة: a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). كِفاية: a kasra under the kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). يُحتاج: a damma over the yā' (3.2 x 5.0 pt). عِلْم: a kasra under the ʿayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun on the head of the lām, joined to it. المُفْرَدة: a damma high over the lām (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt). للبَلَد: a fatha over the bā' and a fatha over the lām, joined in one piece, in both copies. ولِما: a kasra under the lām (3.6 x 2.9 pt). وافَقَ: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (2.9 x 1.8 pt), in both copies. لجميع, البروج, اجزاء, ففيها, فيما, اليه, من and المطالع have no signs.

L03: العَمَل: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt), in both copies. بالجُدَيْوِل: a damma high over the lām (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the yā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt). مَرَاتِب: a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the tā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt), in both copies. المَيْل: a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). عرضه, وهذا, المرسوم, تحت and تربيعة have no signs.

L04: اردتَّ: over the two dots of the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (4.0 x 4.7 pt together). معرِفة: a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt). مَسِير: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the sīn (3.6 x 1.8 pt). المختلِف: a kasra under the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt). لحِساب: a kasra under the ḥā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). باب, اذا, القمر, في, الساعة, الاجتماع, والاستقبال and فخذ have no signs.

L05: المُحْكَم: a damma high over the lām (2.2 x 4.3 pt), a sukun over the ḥā' printed small and broken (1.4 x 2.2 pt), in both copies, and a fatha over the kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). واعرِف: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). يُقابِله: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a kasra under the bā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt). جَداول: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt). والنُّقصان: over the dot of the nūn a shadda with a damma above it (3.6 x 6.8 pt together); no sukun over the qāf, in both copies. حَرَكة: a fatha over the ḥā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). فضل, ما (twice), بين, الشمس, والقمر, في, الزيادة and من have no signs.

L06: لكلّ: a shadda (3.6 x 2.2 pt). خاصَّةً: the first letter has its dot (1.8 x 2.2 pt); over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt), and the fathatan over the two dots of the last letter (4.0 x 3.2 pt). فانقُصه: a damma over the two dots of the qāf, joined to them (4.0 x 6.8 pt together). المُخْتَلِف: a damma high over the lām (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the khā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha close over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a kasra under the lām (3.2 x 1.8 pt). القمر (twice), في (twice), الساعة (twice), وهو, درجة, فما, كان, من (twice), الدقائق and مسير have no signs.

L07: حاصَّة: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 4.0 x 2.2 pt); the first letter has no dot. المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). عرَفْتَ: a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). اذا, كانت, القمر, التي, مسيرها, في, الساعة, من, الى (twice), ومن and وزده have no signs.

L08: الحاصّة: a shadda over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt), without a vowel. بلَغ: a small fatha over the lām (2.5 x 1.4 pt). على, ذلك, المسير (twice), اذا, كانت, تلك, من, الى, فما, بعد, الزيادة, او, النقصان and فهو have no signs.

L09: المُحْكَم: a damma high over the lām (2.5 x 3.6 pt), a round sukun over the ḥā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). فانقُص: a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt). حَرَكة: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt). بَقِيَ: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the qāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), whose two dots stand low under it. سَبْق: a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.2 pt). منه, الشمس, في, الساعة, فما, فهو and القمر have no signs.
